name: pi-config-local
description: Versioned local Pi configuration for macOS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-local/protocol && npm run build -w @pi-local/web && npm run build -w @pi-local/control
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pi-local/protocol && npm run test -w @pi-local/control && npm run test -w @pi-local/web && node --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/router/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pi-local/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @pi-local/control && npm run typecheck -w @pi-local/web
